### 11. Data

| Element | Direction | Counterparty | Content |
|---|---|---|---|
| Catalog file | Read | Chart | Keys, types, ranges, defaults, owners and environments; no personal data and no secret value |
| Catalog | Read | Owner's operation | Catalog rows through the owner's operation |
| Secret references | Read | Key store | References only, never the values |
| Release record | Write | Platform release record | Service, environment, image, chart values, library version, startedAt, endedAt, status PASSED or FAILED |
